newsitem.title: USA: G10 says sound financial institutions vital.
newsitem.headline: G10 says sound financial institutions vital.

text.p: The Group of 10 on Sunday said it was vital to make sure financial institutions were sound as part of measures to promote economic growth and stability.

"(Ministers) stressed that adherence to sound and consistent policies was crucial to maintaining financial stability and fostering strong and sustainable macroeconomic performance," the G10 said in a statement.
The Group underscored the importance of sound financial insitutions and of robust financial market structures to ensure the stability of the international financial system.
The statement also urged increased cooperation among the relevant authorities to strengthen the financial systems of emerging market economies.
